observations: A large black angular figure dominates the center, outlined in pale blue, with bent limbs suggesting forward motion and a wedge-shaped head tilted toward the upper right.
The head contains two tightly wound spiral forms in red, orange, and yellow against a dark interior, and a jagged white zigzag line runs along the open lower edge of the head.
The teal background is covered on both sides with horizontal wavy lines drawn in black with yellow outlines; the lower ground area is filled with loose yellow-green hatching strokes.
reading: A black figure leans forward across a teal field, its angular mass broken only by a pale blue outline tracing its edges. Inside the wedge-shaped head, two coiled spirals burn red and orange — the sole concentrated color in an otherwise flat silhouette. Wavy lines press in from both sides, and the jagged white zigzag at the jaw reads as raw tension rather than stillness.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between nnotb #48 and nnotb #50 in both title and recorded creation order. Where #48 uses scattered dots and warm earth tones across a soft field, #49 strips everything to flat black and teal, concentrating color only at the spiral forms inside the head.

connections.reason: Both works place tightly looped spiral forms inside a larger dark shape set against a teal ground, making the coiled marks the focal point against an otherwise flat surround.

lookingQuestion: What does the relationship between the dense wavy lines pressing in from both edges and the single open space inside the figure's head draw your eye to first?
ambiguities: The small marks in the lower-left corner resemble a signature or annotation but their content is not fully legible in this image.
nnotb #50 shows a quiet, heavily draped figure with no spiral forms or wavy field lines, making it a weak formal match; it is omitted from connections.
